mcp_use_cases.input: Find tables rated at most 3.
mcp_use_cases.actual_output: I called asset_explorer with object_type=oetable and filters.rating max 3 only. I omitted min because at most 3 is open-ended on the low side.

mcp_use_cases.actual_output: I called asset_explorer with object_type=oetable and filters.popularity min 70 only. I omitted max because at least 70 is open-ended.
